prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: photorealistic transparent foreground product cutout for a sophisticated dark Caffè TTC website.
Primary request: one beautiful golden butter croissant, real artisanal bakery pastry with crisp layered flaky crust, distinct airy folds, delicate toasted caramel ridges.
Style/medium: extremely detailed high-end editorial food photography, natural appetizing butter-gold and warm toasted colors.
Composition/framing: square image, the entire croissant visible and centered with generous transparent margins, three-quarter camera angle looking slightly down, broad crescent silhouette facing viewer, dimensional sculptural form.
Lighting/mood: soft natural warm directional light from upper left, elegant soft photographic shading, bright readable edges for compositing against a nearly black webpage.
Scene/backdrop: truly transparent alpha background, no plate, no table, no surroundings. Subject fully isolated.
Constraints: no holographic appearance, no blue tint, no neon, no glow, no graphics, no text, no logo, no watermark, no extra objects, no cropped edges. Do not render a fake checkerboard. Generate genuine alpha transparency.
